FFmpeg (https://ffmpeg.org) writes the transparent videos (ProRes 4444). It runs as a
program of its own, shipped in the app's "ffmpeg" folder (Windows: resources\ffmpeg next
to Printwarden.exe; macOS: Printwarden.app/Contents/Resources/ffmpeg). Next to it are its
license (LICENSE.txt) and NOTICE.txt: which FFmpeg it is, how it was built, and where its
source code is.

It is FFmpeg 9.0.2, unmodified, built from the official source with only what Printwarden
uses (raw frames in, the scaler, the ProRes encoder, the MOV container) and no other
library: licensed under the GNU Lesser General Public License 2.1 or later. Printwarden
starts it with fixed arguments and passes it frames; it is not linked into Printwarden,
and it can be replaced with any other build of FFmpeg.
